description: This PHP source file defines the 'perf_mysql' class, which provides performance monitoring, statistics retrieval, and optimization functions for MySQL databases within the ADOdb library. It includes methods for fetching table status, query counts, cache hit ratios, and performing table optimization.

classes.name: perf_mysql
classes.description: A class for performance monitoring, query analysis, and database optimization tailored for MySQL using the ADOdb abstraction layer.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with a database connection reference.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Generates and returns an EXPLAIN plan for a given SQL SELECT query.

methods.name: tables
methods.description: Returns an HTML formatted table status report from the database.

methods.name: GetReads
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of SELECT queries executed, using MySQL status variables.

methods.name: GetWrites
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of write operations (INSERT, DELETE, UPDATE) executed, using MySQL status variables.

methods.name: FindDBHitRatio
methods.description: Determines the cache hit ratio based on the table type (MyISAM or InnoDB).

methods.name: GetQHitRatio
methods.description: Calculates the query cache hit ratio based on MySQL status variables.

methods.name: GetInnoDBHitRatio
methods.description: Retrieves InnoDB buffer pool hit ratio by parsing InnoDB status output.

methods.name: GetKeyHitRatio
methods.description: Calculates the index key read ratio from MySQL status variables.

methods.name: optimizeTable
methods.description: Performs table optimization with specified mode (low or high).
